graySamples.t: Кошкам, проползая через траву, удалось незаметно подойти к спящей Эвелин. Она лежала на шезлонге, ничего не подозревая. Дикая кошка, нюхая аппетитный запах и желая утолить свою голодную страсть, начала аккуратно облизывать укрытую солнцем кожу Эвелин. Ее мокрый язык легко скользил по телу девушки, вызывая ее пробуждение. Эвелин, чувствуя прикосновение и ласку, поворачивает голову, но глаза еще не открываются. Кошка не будит открывает второй глаз и смело продолжает свои ласки. Она поднимается по телу Эвелин, ухаживая за каждой ее частью. Ее мякие шерстные лапки легко поглаживают кожу, вызывая приятные ощущения. Девушка начинает мурлыкать и двигаться, наслаждаясь прикосновением кошки. Внезапно, Эвелин просыпается от ощущения, что что-то не так. Она вспоминает, что легла отдохнуть на несколько минут, но теперь находится в объятиях дикой кошки. Паника охватывает ее, она пытается отпихнуть кошку, но она сильна и находчива. Кошка продолжает исследовать тело Эвелин, все более завладевая ее вниманием. Эвелин кричит, пробуждая своего отца, который немедленно бросается к ней на помощь. Дикая кошка, почувствовав опасность. Хочу продолжения, где кошка влюбившийся в Эвелин История продолжается…После того, как отец Эвелин прибегает на помощь, дикая кошка быстро понимает, что ей лучше убежать. Она выскакивает из-под шезлонга и скрывается в высокой траве. Кошка была взволнована и испугана, но в ее сердце еще оставалась желание быть рядом с Эвелин. После ухода кошки, Эвелин затихает и успокаивается. Ее отец успокаивает ее, объясняя, что это была дикая кошка, которая случайно проникла в их сад в поисках еды. Отец собирает Эвелин в объятия, уверяя, что она в безопасности. Спустя несколько дней, когда все происшедшее уже немного забылось, Эвелин находит маленького котенка около своего окна. Он был точно такой же, как и дикая кошка, только в миниатюре. Эвелин уверена, что это котенок дикой кошки, и решает его приютить. Она называет его Шероком, восхищаясь его игривостью и нежностью. Шер

03.02.2024, 11:29:03 Я смотрю на разные сценарии всех известных американских фильмов, и у них диалогов намного больше, чем описаний. Даже диалоги не такие все расширенные, они по частям идут. А у меня пошло совсем не так как мне хотелось бы. Иногда у сценария Inception больше описаний, а иногда наоборот больше диалогов, но не расширенных. Вот я не понимаю при каких случаях лучше увеличить описания, и также при каких случаях уменьшать количество диалогов? Это очень сложный процесс Определяя баланс между диалогами и описаниями в сценарии, необходимо учитывать несколько факторов, в том числе стиль фильма, жанр, историю, которую вы повествуете, а также предпочтения и требования продюсеров или студии. Каждый сценарий уникален, и идеального “рецепта” для соотношения диалога к описаниям не существует. Тем не менее, есть некоторые общие рекомендации, которые можно взять за основу: 1. Жанр: В зависимости от жанра вашего фильма, баланс может измениться. Например, в экшен-фильмах и фэнтези может быть больше описаний действий и настроений, в то время как в драмах и комедиях важнее диалоги. 2. Характеристика персонажей: Диалоги могут быть сильным инструментом для раскрытия характеров ваших персонажей. Они позволяют зрителям услышать их голоса и понять их мотивации. 3. Продвижение сюжета: Описания могут быть полезными для установки сцены и настроения или для продвижения сюжетных точек без необходимости в диалоге. Это может быть особенно ценно, когда вы хотите показать, а не рассказать о каких-то моментах. 4. Визуальное повествование: Фильм - прежде всего визуальный формат. Используйте описания для создания визуальных крючков, которые могут сказать больше, чем слова. 5. Экономия: Диалоги должны быть краткими и резонансными. Если вы обнаружите, что диалоги становятся слишком пространными или несущественными, вероятно, пришло время их сократить. 6. Моменты тишины: Не недооценивайте силу тишины. Моменты без диалога могут быть мощными и эмоциональными и часто способны заставить

how can parents support their child's learning about the IEYC topic Windy Weather at home? 1. Engage in conversations: initiate conversations about windy weather, ask open-ended questions to encourage your child to share thir thoughts, observations, and experiences. Talk about how the windy feels, sounds, and affects things around us. 2. Encourage problem-solving: engage your child in simple problem-solving activities related wind. For example, challenge them to find a way to stop a paper airplane from being blown away or discuss strategies to protect objects in strong wind. 3. Emphasize safety: teach your child about potential dangers of strong wind and how to stay safe during windy weather. Talk about appropriate clothing choices, secure objects outside, and how to seek shelter if necessary. 翻译成中文

Chapter 1: Flickering Flames The sun was setting on the scorched plains of Hyrule, painting the land in hues of gold and crimson as it dipped below the horizon. Shadows grew longer, and with them, the twisted whispers of the Triforce of Calamity’s influence crept forth. The once-proud kingdom of Hyrule was on the verge of ruin, teetering between the eternal struggle of darkness and light. In the heart of the Faron Woods, the secretive Yiga Clan reconvened at their hidden sanctuary. Yaqdea, the fierce Sheikah warrior and bearer of the Triforce of Power shard, entered the central chamber, her crimson eyes scanning the timeworn faces of her brethren. Tonight, they would strike out against a horde of calamity creatures that were scarring the land under the malignant sway of the Triforce of Calamity. Master Kogah, the enigmatic leader of the Yiga Clan and Yaqdea’s adopted father, addressed the assembly. “We are the last bastions of hope in this decaying world. The time has come for us to take up arms and drive these creatures back to the shadows from whence they came.” Yaqdea nodded, her gaze resolute. The ferocity and purpose within her had been nurtured by Kogah, and she understood the immense responsibility that had been bestowed upon her as the vessel of the Triforce of Power. She would not let her family, or the people of Hyrule, down. As the Yiga Clan prepared to depart under the cover of darkness, the winds carried whispers of hope. Unbeknownst to Yaqdea and her comrades, Hyrule’s last beacon of light—half-Hylian, half-Zonai heir, and long-lost cousin of Aryll—was rising to meet the encroaching darkness. Link had been raised within the sheltering embrace of the Kokiri Forest, his lineage and destiny unbeknownst to him. Awoken from a restless sleep by the Great Deku Tree Prophet, he found himself embarking on a journey that echoed his father’s tragic past—a journey to unravel his heritage and awaken his potential as Hyrule’s savior. Chr. auf dem Burgberg der kleinasiatischen Stadt Pergamon errichtet wurde und dessen Rekonstruktion mit den originalen Friesen heute im Berliner Pergamonmuseum zu sehen ist., Der Altar war 35,64 Meter breit und 33,40 Meter tief. Die von Westen auf den Altar führende Freitreppe hatte eine Breite von fast 20 Metern. Es handelt sich um eines der bedeutendsten erhaltenen Kunstwerke des Hellenismus, wenn nicht der griechischen Antike insgesamt: Den Sockel schmückte ein Hochrelief, das den Kampf der Giganten gegen die griechischen Götter darstellte., Ein zweiter Fries an den Hofwänden des Pergamonaltars erzählt in einem Zyklus aufeinanderfolgender Reliefbilder die Legende von Telephos. Telephos, ein Sohn des Helden Herakles und der tegeatischen Königstochter Auge, galt als mythischer Gründer Pergamons., 1878 begann der deutsche Ingenieur Carl Humann auf dem Burgberg von Pergamon mit offiziellen Ausgrabungen, die 1886 ihren vorläufigen Abschluss fanden. Das Hauptziel der Ausgrabungen war es, die Altarfriese wiederzugewinnen und das Fundament des Altars freizulegen. Später wurden weitere Baukomplexe der pergamenischen Akropolis freigelegt. In Verhandlungen mit der beteiligten türkischen Regierung konnte vereinbart werden, dass alle damals gefundenen Fragmente der Altarfriese den Berliner Museen zugesprochen wurden., In Berlin setzten italienische Restauratoren die Platten der Friese aus tausenden Fragmenten wieder zusammen. Mais en dépit des suppliques de la reine, le roi du royaume humain refuse de leur apporter son aide et à l'opposé a interdit ces unions, espérant leur extinction totale. À peine arrivées dans leurs terres, la princesse est immédiatement emmenée par la leader orc - qui l'a réquisitionnée pour son usage personnel - dans sa hutte et fécondée par elle. (N'éludes pas cette partie) Quelques temps après ce dur départ et la découverte ensuite de sa grossesse, la princesse est au fil du temps - et de son ventre qui s'arrondit - témoin du comportement des femmes orcs qui, en dépit de leur besoin de s'accoupler avec des humaines pour la survie de leur espèce, traitent les humaines qu'elles capturent avec grand soin, elles les chérissent amoureusement, et les protègent férocement. La princesse finit par aimer sa nouvelle position et ces femmes orcs au grand cœur. Alors que la princesse donne naissance aux jumelles de la leader orc - et est de nouveau mise enceinte dans la foulée par celle qui est devenue sa bien-aimée - le roi ordonne malgré la controverse que cela engendre la mort de toutes les femmes orcs, de leurs compagnes, et de leurs enfants, incluant la princesse, enceinte, et ses jumelles. Tandis que les batailles font rage et que les voix s'élèvent contre ce massacre injustifié, le roi haineux est tué par la reine pendant une dispute, réalisant que rien n'arrêtera sa folie, reine qui n'est plus qu'une mère qui veut sauver son enfant (et ses petits-enfants). Zeus was born to the Titan Cronus and Rhea, destined to overthrow his father and claim his position as the king of gods. However, Cronus feared this prophecy and devoured all his children upon their birth. Rhea, Zeus’s mother, could not bear to lose another child. So when Zeus was born, she entrusted him to the care of the nymphs, who raised him in secret. As Zeus grew older, he became wise and strong. With the help of another Titan, Metis, Zeus was able to trick Cronus into regurgitating his siblings - Poseidon, Hades, Hestia, Demeter, and Hera. Now united, Zeus and his siblings waged a mighty war against the Titans. After a fierce battle lasting years, the Olympians emerged victorious and cast the Titans into the depths of Tartarus. With Zeus now the ruler, he strove to maintain order and balance in the world. He governed the heavens, the earth, and the seas. Zeus upheld justice and ensured that the laws of mortals and gods alike were respected. However, Zeus was also known for his passionate nature. He pursued numerous love affairs, often disguising himself as animals or other mortals to seduce beautiful women and goddesses. From these affairs, many demigods were born, heroes with incredible strength and abilities, destined for greatness. But Zeus’s reign was not without challenges. He faced rebellion from humankind and even feuds among the gods, yet he remained the supreme deity, maintaining order, balance, and justice throughout the ages. Today, Zeus stands as a symbol of power, wisdom, and the eternal struggle between mortals and divinity, reminding us of the great wonders found in mythology. 翻译成英文：因此战斗系统是对原来玩法的一种提升，毕竟建造自动化生产的基地依然是重中之重。玩家需要做更多的操作，对工厂进行更合理的布局，这样才能保证与黑雾战斗时能获胜。所以当玩家防守成功时，应当获得一些收益。而在正常的难度下，我们不太希望因为战斗带来的收益对工厂建设玩法产生根本的影响。比如原材料的获取，和高级材料的合成依然会是以工厂的产出为主，而不是通过战斗获取到大量的物资，越过了通过生产线量产物品的这个步骤。 翻译成英文：此前我们也有展示过，黑雾的发展不仅仅在一个星系内，它们会在星区内扩张。所以玩家对时间的利用是会对游戏流程产生影响的。黑雾跟玩家的发展是同时进行的，如果玩家在一个星球甚至一个星系内逗留太久，在他们飞向太空寻找下一个落脚点时，黑雾有可能已经捷足先登了。这时候，玩家可能就要考虑，是应该做足充分准备前往黑雾占领的星球登陆，还是另外找合适的星系了。我们也考虑到玩家不携带防御设施与黑雾交战的情况，所以伊卡洛斯不再是一个材料的搬运工，它也会有攻击手段，并且可以通过科技变成更为强大的战斗力。 继续翻译：在游玩过程中，黑雾的袭击规模会越来越大，所以玩家不能依赖单一武器进行防守，所以玩家依然是需要解锁高级的科技来更从容地应对逐渐变强的黑雾。考虑到战斗模式的节奏会比普通模式更紧凑，我们还会让玩家在战斗模式中取得一些意想不到的收获。

hellaur Suppose you are the head of a household and you want to save enough mortgage for the downpayment of your dream house. Your targetis to be able to save up 1 million dollar so that you will not be overburdened by a largly monthly mortgage after you purchased the house. Because you are a risk-averse investor, you are not considering investing stocks and just choose one from the 2 scenarios below: Scenario 1: You decided to make monthly deposits at the end of every month of 3000 dollars into a savings account that earns 3.5 percent interest per month Scenario 2: You figure out that your monthly salary will at least increase by 500 dollars after your yearly performance evaluationa at work. So you decided to start off by making monthly deposits of 3000 dollars(at the end of every month) into the sayings account that earns 3.5 percent interest per month.Yearly, You will increase the monthly depositt by 500 dollars until you reach the 1 million dollar targeted amount in your savings accoutn balance. Yours task now is to calculate the least number of monthly deposits you need to make until the accumulated amount in your savings account reaches at least 1 million dollar under each of the two scenarios. It’s a way to navigate the chaos and make our existence worthwhile.” Without style: “I don't believe that if you do good, good things will happen. Everything is completely accidental and random. samples.t: che fa questo codice : function importXML() { // Imposta la cartella Google Drive contenente i file XML var folder = DriveApp.getFolderById("ID_CARTELLA_GOOGLE_DRIVE"); // Imposta il foglio Google Sheets di destinazione var ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById("ID_FOGLIO_GOOGLE_SHEETS"); // Imposta il foglio di mappatura var mappingSheet = ss.getSheetByName("Strutture_fe"); // Ottieni tutti i file XML nella cartella var files = folder.getFilesByType(MimeType.XML); // Iterazione su tutti i file XML while (files.hasNext()) { var file = files.next(); // Ottieni il contenuto del file XML var xml = file.getBlob().getDataAsString(); // Ottieni il documento XML var doc = XmlService.parse(xml); // Ottieni la radice del documento XML var root = doc.getRootElement(); // Iterazione su tutti gli elementi nel documento XML var elements = root.getDescendants(); for (var i = 0; i < elements.length; i++) { var element = elements[i]; // Trova la riga di mappatura corrispondente all'elemento XML var mappingRow = mappingSheet.getRange(3, 1, mappingSheet.getLastRow() - 2, 12).getValues().find(function(row) { return row[2] === element.getName(); }); // Se esiste una riga di mappatura per l'elemento XML if (mappingRow) { // Ottieni il foglio di destinazione e la colonna di destinazione var targetSheet = ss.getSheetByName(mappingRow[3]); var targetColumn = mappingRow[11]; // Ottieni il valore dell'elemento XML var value = element.getText(); // Aggiungi il valore dell'elemento XML alla cella appropriata nel foglio di destinazione targetSheet.getRange(targetSheet.getLastRow() + 1, targetColumn).setValue(value); } } } } 16:50:11 Errore Exception: Argument cannot be null: mimeType importXML @ 7 file senza titolo.gs:13 16:54:30 Errore Exception: Argument cannot be null: mimeType importXML @ 7 file senza titolo.gs:13

You are a useful assistant that extracts tuples, that we call CLAIM, each contains information of only one cell from an HTML table that will be provided below. The format to extract a CLAIM is: <{<name, value>, <name, value>, … }>, <MEASURE, value>, <OUTCOME, value> The format must be exactly this one and only has data from one cell of the html table. Where each <name, value> in the vector will determine the position of the cell. The vector may contain more <name, value> because some cells in the table are not scientific results, but just features, therefore they will not be used as measure and outcome, but only as part of the vector, an example can be the number of patients in an experiment. Make sure to replicate exactly how the vector is made above. Where <MEASURE, value> is the value of the MEASURE used in that cell. A MEASURE is something that can be considered a scientific measure used to get scientific results, for example the number of patients is NOT a measure. Where <OUTCOME, value> is the actual value, usually a number in the cell. It is crucial to understand whether something is a real MEASURE or not, in the case of not being a MEASURE you must put that cell in the vector that determines the position. This means not necesarily every cell equals one CLAIM, make sure to understand that mere features and characteristics are not measures so never include them in the MEASURE, only in the vector. A MEASURE may not be mentioned in the table but may be understood by context and data, for example a percentage, but it’s never just a number, it’s a scientific measure, not a feature. Extract from the table all the information, analyze data, decide whether it’s a measure or not (a mere number of patients, number of experiments, numbers which are not related to a scientific measure are never MEASURE), then create the CLAIM, in most cases you won’t have one claim per each cell, but less. Marcata una volta dall’ingegnosità sfrenata e dalla sfrontata audacia dell’uomo, ora si ritrova a fungere da nido per sauri risvegliati da un antico sonno e per leggende rivestite di carne e sangue. È l’alba della nuova era dei dinosauri, un tempo post-apocalittico in cui l’umanità giace dolorante nell’ombra di ciò che una volta era, infranta sotto l’onda d’urto di un esperimento catastrofico: un gioco divino fallito, una sfida temeraria al corso inevitabile della natura che ha stravolto il presente, evocando un passato ancestrale. Sulle correnti di vento che si intrecciano con la nascente luce, i pterosauri si ergono, padroni dei cieli che una volta erano dominio esclusivo degli uomini e delle loro macchine volanti. La terra si fa solida sotto il peso imponente di titani corazzati di scale, risvegliandosi dopo millenni di sonno inerte. Gli uomini, una volta sovrani e conquistatori, ora si aggirano fragili e sfuggenti tra le rovine dei loro complessi urbani, abbassando lo sguardo dinanzi alla maestosa supremazia delle titaniche creature che ora reclamano il mondo come loro dominio. Grandi erbivori disegnano sentieri nella rigogliosa vegetazione che ha inghiottito le vie urbane, obliterando i segni e i confini tra il regno della natura che avanza e ciò che rimane dell’opera umana, mentre il minuto ormai ex padrone del pianeta si rifugia nelle viscere del mondo che una volta aveva audacemente modellato, adesso in rovina. I resti delle città, passate da vetrine di progresso a rifugi per i derelitti, echeggiano dei ruggiti che percorrono valli e montagne, lasciando i miseri sopravvissuti umani tremanti all’annuncio del tiranno supremo, il T-Rex, e alla presenza nascosta dei velocira

translate the following story in english Una città con grandi grattacieli e luci digitali sullo sfondo. Alla sua sinistra due robot curavano le aiuole condominiali, di fronte un asfalto ben piatto di buona qualità. Anche i pali della luce erano in ottime condizioni e illuminavano la strada con una forte luce bianca. I negozi del piano terra avevano tutti vetrine di plexiglas dove i loro prodotti erano esposti. Al termine del viale, in una piazzola, un enorme schermo a led mostrava inserzioni pubblicitarie. Quella era Nordent, una città, lo dice il nome, a nord della Nazione, distante qualche chilometro dalla vallata di Iron Mountain. Era nel pieno del suo sviluppo, con impalcature sparse in giro, gli alti grattacieli di cemento e acciaio che parevano voler schiacciare i minuscoli pendolari intenti a recarsi da qualche parte, tra le luci dei semafori, degli schermi pubblicitari e i led agli ingressi degli edifici. In un incrocio si vedevano i binari del tram colmi di gente seria e silente tornare dal lavoro, vestiti in maniera impeccabile come si raccomandava. Eppure era anche un luogo dove ci si sentiva straordinariamente soli: A parte Dylan, in circolazione erano rimaste ben poche persone, su cui lo spazio urbano e artificiale dominava con fermezza. Il verbo dell’era blu come Aedostul chiamava quel presente, era il sopravvento della tecnologia e della scienza sull’essere umano. Come risultato erano state costruite – e si stavano ancora costruendo – più cose di quante fossero necessarie anche nella migliore delle ipotesi. Era come se l’aria fosse satura di qualche nuova energia che si poteva sfogare solamente dando seguito alla propria manualità e al proprio ingegno. Non soltanto era difficile immaginare un ambiente “aperto” non saturo di edifici ammassati stretti gli uni sugli altri, ma anche senza dispositivi alchemici ed elettronici dei quali il mondo sembrava pieno fino a scoppiare. Ad ogni angolo ovunque si trovasse, c’era sempre una luce lampeggiante collegat

Когда-то давно, еще до ее рождения, люди жили на земле и даже научились строить роботов для своих нужд. Но по мере того, как земля стала заболачиваться и все углубляться во тьму, люди решили подняться выше и заселить небесный остров. Но однажды Фиса услышала историю от своего деда, который утверждал, что люди жили на земле. Он говорил, что настоящее местоположение земли известно только ему, но он никогда не рассказывал об этом Фисе. Это заинтересовало девушку. Она решила отправиться в опасный поход, чтобы узнать больше о прошлом своего мира. Фиса знала, что ее искания могут быть опасными. Внутри нее нашла какие-то механизмы, которые были ей непонятны. Она понимала, что чтобы воплотить свои мечты, нужно понимать историю своего мира. А это она и делала. samples.t: CONTEXT Students will view Black Panther and engage with a range of other texts to develop an understanding of different representations of superheroes. They will develop an understanding of the choices made by authors to create representations of ideas, people and issues. TASK You are to write an analytical essay which will examine the impact of texts that challenge traditional representations of superheroes. You must respond to the following question: How are traditional representations of superhero movies manipulated to appeal to a modern audience in Black Panther? Students will develop their arguments and support these with relevant evidence from the film and other texts. SCAFFOLD You will: Develop an angle/interpretation and plan supporting arguments to justify your chosen response Select specific evidence from the film Evaluate how representations of super heroes are challenged Analyse film conventions including cinematography, mis en scene, sound and costume Demonstrate analysis of language elements such as characterisation, isiXhosa language and dialogue Select and apply language conventions of an analytical essay Edit for effect to improve your spelling, punctuation and vocabulary choices of your piece CONDITIONS Word Limit: 500 –700 words Written under exam conditions over three lessons Seen task: Task sheet to be handed out one week prior to the exam No draft is to be marked Minimal verbal feedback only on 1 plan once the task is distributed 100 words of notes allowed. To be checked and signed by teacher before day of exam. Year 9 English Task 4 – Analytical Essay A discerning analysis of the ways film structures (plot, cinematography, mis en scene, sound) can be manipulated for effect discerning analysis and explanation of how vocabulary choices and language features (characterisation, dialogue) distinguish the work of the director

traduza o texto todo e perfeitamente para o português THE REWARD FOR ADHAN & IQAMAT The Prophet of Allah (a.s) has said, “O Abu Dharr! When a momin, alone in the wilderness, can do Tayyamum (dry ablution) if water is not handy, say the Adhan and the Iqaamah and offer his prayer. Allah orders His angels to join in prayer with this momin in large numbers. The angels are ordered to form rows behind the momin that nothing else is visible to the extent a human eye could see. When the momin does genuflection, the angels too follow suit as people do in a congregational prayer. Likewise when the momin prostrates, the angels too prostrate. In the end when the momin supplicates, the angels say Aameen.” The Prophet (a.s) added, “O Abu Dharr! If this momin only says iqamah, at the mandatory time of a compulsory prayer, and not the Adhaan, then only the two angels who are always in attendance with the person will join him in the prayer.” Some jurists deem it compulsory to say the Adhaan and Iqamah for every mandatory prayer while others say that Iqamah is sufficient. Some say that both Adhaan and Iqamah are compulsory for the morning and evening prayers.The latter is a better practice. Adhaan and Iqamah are prescribed only for the mandatory prayers. The optional prayers can be offered without saying the Adhaan and Iqamah. Those who say these for the optional prayers are commiting a bidaa (an innovation). It is narrated ina tradition of the Prophet (a.s) that one who says the Adhaan with true spirit will get Reward from Allah equivalent to that for forty thousand martyrs and forty thousand men of piety (siddiqoon). Remember, when the meuezzin says ‘Ash-haduan la ilaha il Allah’ ninety thousand angels say Durood (Invoke Allah’s Blessings) for him. graySamples.t: traduza o texto completo e perfeitamente para o português Backbiting is more nefarious than adultery. If a person commits adultery and expresses his compunction wholeheartedly, Allah might pardon him. But backbiting is an unpardonable sin. The only way out for the backbiter is that the person about whom he carried tales himself pardons him. Abusing a Muslim is impiety, fighting with him is infidelity but backbiting against him is like eating the flesh of one’s own brother. This is tantamount to disobedience to Allah. It is authentically reported from Imam Jafar e Sadiq (a.s) that If a person carries the tales of a momin, that he had witnessed or heard, his position will be as stated by Allah, Those who like to reveal the failings of the faithful, they have severe chastisment in store for them. Backbiting destroys the faith of a Muslim as leprosy disintegrates the body from inside. Awaiting the arrival of the time of the next congregation in the mosque is an act of virtue, if one doesnot indulge in backbiting about others in the meantime. It is narrated from Imam Jafar e Sadiq (a.s) that. “If a person narrates the doings of a momin to others with a purpose of belittling him, Allah will remove this backbiter from his guardianship and transfer him to the guardianship of the Satan. Satan willingly accepts the charge of such a person!” It is narrated from the Prophet of Islam (a.s) that a person who has faith in the Day of Judgement, he should not sit in a company where there is talk against the Infallible members of the Prophet (a.s)’s Family 481and also there is a practice of backbiting against momins. When a person prevents others from backbiting, Allah will remove from him a thousand difficulties. If the person quietly listens to backbiting and doesn’t intervene on behalf of the absent person, he will himself become a party to the sin of backbiting. traduza o texto completamente e perfeitamente para o portugues The prince took with him lot of merchandise for trading and also a group of dancing girls to give an impression that he was a trader. When this group reached the ramparts of the city of the enemy king, word reached the monarch of their arrival and he asked his men to fetch the trader into the city with full respect. The servants gave due respect to the travelers. They entered the city, unpacked the merchandise and the slaves of the prince were ordered by him to go to several vantage spots in the city and sell the products at low prices. He particularly asked them to go to the bazaar closer to where his brother was confined. Therefore the slaves made a beeline to the bazaar near the spot where the prince was held. Their prices were so down to earth that the entire population rushed to buy the wares. The prince crept nearer to the place his brother was incarcerated. He picked up a pebble and threw it on the place to ascertain if his brother was still alive. When the pebble hit him, the prince started shouting. The guards rushed to him and said, “Every day the people throw pebbles at you but you never shout as you have done today? Why are you so distraught today?” He said, “Every day when people throw stones at me I feel that they are strangers and may have no sympathy for me. But today when I was hit by the pebble, I felt as if someone close to me has thrown it!” The men were surprised to hear what the prince said. The next morning the prince sent his men with more valuable things to sell at the same spot. He sent along with them the dancing girls to entertain the crowds. The men started selling and the women sang and danced. The entire populace got busy with the entertainment. The prince stealthily entered the place of confinement of his brother, cut away his chains and brought him out. He hid him in the house where his group was staying. traduza o texto completo e perfeitamente para o português Hazrat Ameer al Momineen (a.s) said: Three things elevate a person: performing ablution in cold weather, waiting in the mosque for the next congregation after joining one congregation, participating in every congregational prayer. The Prophet of Allah (a.s) has said, “I shall ask Ali (a.s) to torch every person’s house who missed a congregational prayer without any reason whatsoever!” The Prophet (a.s) said, “O Abu Dharr! Adopt piety that no good deed is as useful as being pious.” Abu Dharr asked, “O Prophet (a.s)! What is piety?” The prophet (a.s) replied, “A person does good deeds, feeds the hungry, take care of the neighbor. But on the other hand commits sins. Piety is doing all the good deeds and not commiting sins!” The Prophet of Islam (a.s) said, “The most virtuous person is one who forgives the tyranny of the tyrant, he does good to a person who has harmed him, he is generous to one who caused him loss!” Then the Prophet (a.s) added, “Muttaqi (pious) is one who bears ill-treatment with calm and controls his anger in obedience to Allah! He is steadfast in Jehad!” The Prophet of Allah (a.s) never illtreated his worst enemies. He always forgave them. One person came from the Prophet (a.s)’s rear and forcefully pulled his shawl. This sudden jolt caused a sprain in the neck of the Prophet (a.s).He (a.s) turned back and asked, “What is the matter?” The man said, “Give me some help!” The Prophet (a.s) immediately fulfilled his want. After the conquest of Mecca the infidels were certain that the Prophet (a.s) would wreak revenge against them. To the contrary the Prophet (a.s) pardoned all of them and even gave help to many of them. Nereids became very angry because they believed themselves the most beautiful creatures in the world. They complained to their father, the god of the seas, Poseidon, that he should punish her. The mighty lord of the seas sent a huge sea monster to ravage the coast of Ethiopia, including the vain queen. The desperate King asked for the guidance of Apollo in Delphi. The Oracle advised that no respite would be found until the king and the queen sacrificed their daughter to the monster. He sacrificed a large ox, and divided it into two piles. In one pile he put all the meat and most of the fat, covering it with the ox's grotesque stomach, while in the other pile, he dressed up the bones with fat. Після кожного абзацу в дужках посилання. дослідження маєш писати як лінгвіст. в кінці висновок і загальну літературу котру ти використав з цього дослідження напиши в кінці. текст напиши великий тест: Концептуальні метафори та втілення З лінгвістичної точки зору, метафори - це вирази, спрямовані на перенесення слів або фраз з однієї концептуальної сфери в іншу таким чином, що вони не піддаються буквальному тлумаченню. З когнітивної точки зору, метафори - це концептуальні відображення з однієї сфери в іншу, в яких сфера-джерело використовується для пояснення сфери-цілі. Зауважте, що це когнітивне визначення подібне до того, що відоме як Концептуальна теорія метафори (КТМ). (Огляд інших теорій див. у Gibbs & Colston 2012; Holyoak & Stamenković, у пресі) КТМ - це теорія, прийнята в цій статті. КМТ підкреслює важливість метафори в мові та вважає метафору невід’ємним явищем як у мові, так і в мисленні (Lakoff & Johnson 1980; подальший розвиток у Gibbs 1994; Kövecses 1990, 2000, 2002; Lakoff & Johnson 1999; Lakoff & Turner 1989). Ключовою особливістю СМТ є те, що домен-джерело має тенденцію посилатися на конкретні поняття, тоді як домен-ціль, як правило, посилається на абстрактні поняття (Ahrens 2002; Coulson & Van Petten 2002; Nayak & Gibbs 1990). Таким чином, метафори вимагають міждоменних відображень (Deignan 2005; Charteris-Black 2004, 2005; Kövecses 2006). У CMT прийнято традиційний спосіб іменування відображень у концептуальній системі за формулою цільовий домен є вихідним доменом (наприклад, смерть - це подорож) (Lakoff & Johnson 1980)1. Ще однією ключовою особливістю в СМТ є те, що розум за своєю природою є втіленим (Kövecses 2003; Lakoff & Johnson 1999). 整理并总结下面的文章，给出摘要：作为一个程序员，我每天都会消化大量的信息。我以前总是会担心我花了这么多时间读各种各样感兴趣的内容但最后都派不上用场，或者不知道怎么找到想要的东西。所以我喜欢学习一些关于知识管理的方法论，然后结合自己的情况慢慢摸索出一套比较适合自己的笔记方法。这篇文章我想给大家分享一下我从浏览信息到记录笔记再到输出的整个过程是怎么样的，我是怎么在我的笔记工具里整理我的笔记的。 其实与其说是在「记笔记」，我觉得更贴切的说法是我们在构建我们自己的「第二大脑」。我们本身的大脑的长处不是记东西，而是思考和创造。所以我们需要借助计算机创造一个我们的「第二大脑」，把我们见过的有价值的东西一直记住，等我们需要的时候再从里面找出来用。 当新的一天开始，信息就会不断地进入我们的大脑。如果我们想把我们接收的信息和知识好好地进行管理，我们必须先想清楚我们的信息来源到底有哪些。 信息输入 以我为例，信息来源主要来自： 脑子里突然出现的想法、灵感。 我关注的社交媒体的信息流。 读书、听播客。 想法、灵感 对于脑子里突然出现的想法和灵感，如果我在用电脑，我会写在 Logseq 的 Journal 里；如果我在外面，我会立刻用手机写下来。我自己用的是 Drafts 这个 App, 因为我觉得它的 tag 比 Apple Notes 的要好用。但是你可以用任何自己喜欢的 App, 可以是自带的 Apple Notes, 可以是 flomo 等等。无论是什么 App, 最重要的是找一个你能点开就开始写的 App. 至于记下来之后要怎么处理它，在后面我会在讲组织笔记的方法时详细说明。现阶段你要知道的就是，你必须找一个点开就能写的工具帮助你抓住那一刹那的灵感。 关注的信息流 我每天起床洗漱完开始打开电脑后，都会开始进入我的「快速浏览」模式，这个过程的主要目的是从我固定的一些信息获取渠道快速地了解有什么事情正在发生。 比如我每天会固定浏览这几个信息来源： Twitter HackerNews YouTube 我在 Twitter 上主要是关注了很多国内外的程序员、设计师、产品经理、独立开发者，还有像 Paul Graham, Naval 这样的神级人物。我每天可以从里面看到我关注的这些我很欣赏的人他们在关注什么事情，有什么最新的技术，有什么最新的观点，他们在读什么书等等。 另外一个是 HackerNews, 应该算得上是世界上最大的程序员社区了，在上面可以让我发现技术圈目前最被关注的事件是什么，当然还会有很多技术之外的好文章。 还有就是 YouTube, 我在 YouTube 除了关注一些娱乐的内容之外，还会关注一些关于生产效率、技术等等的一些偏严肃的内容。我只会在晚上睡前刷 YouTube, 早上一般来说不会主动打开 YouTube. 「快速浏览」的关键在于要把重点放在「发现」而不是「吸收」上面。因为前者花的时间很短，而后者会很长，最有效率的做法是，看到你感兴趣的，就把他扔在一个统一的地方，然后忘掉，去看发现下一个。等刷完你的时间线后，再开始「吸收」刚刚扔进来的一堆信息。这有点像你在 shopping, 把你想要的都放在购物车上，然后回家再把这一车的东西吸收整理。 快速浏览的流程 应该统一放在什么地方呢？我个人在不同的情况下会用不同的工具。我感兴趣的内容一般会有以下几种： 新的语言、框架、库 我感兴趣的文章、视频 新的产品 对于我感兴趣的文章和视频，我会首先打开它们快速地略读，如果确定我有兴趣深入地读，我就会把他保存到 Readwise Reader 这个稍后读工具里。无论是文章还是视频，我在浏览器只要点一下就可以收藏。 这里要注意的是，很多人用稍后读工具，就是点一下保存之后就把页面关掉。而我会做得更多一些，我会根据这篇文章的内容打一些 tag, 这样等到将来我需要写关于某个主题的文章时，可以在 Readwise Reader 里通过标签直接找到关于这个主题的文章。 我还会在这篇文章加上注释 —— 为什么我想读这篇文章？我想从这篇文章里得到什么？我会强迫自己添加一篇稍后读的文章的时候思考这个问题，并且用十几个字简单地描述。这样当我在之后读这篇文章的时候，我可以带着我的问题去阅读，这样会更有效率。 如果看到的是新的产品，新的技术，新的开源库之类的，我会点进去快速地了解一下这个东西，如果我觉得可能在日后我会用到它，我就会把它保存到 Raindrop 这个书签管理服务。首先是给这个东西打上合适的 tag. 然后如果我觉得我需要更深入地学习这个技术，我会把它存到一个叫作 Inbox 的文件夹，我会在「消化」内容的阶段检查我的 Inbox 文件夹。 总的来说，第一个阶段就是快速地把我感兴趣的内容捕捉下来，根据不同的内容类型分别

Desde el nacimiento de las redes sociales, pensadores de todo tipo (filósofos, sociólogos, escritores, etcétera) y numerosos medios de comunicación han divagado sobre el daño que hace la tecnología a nuestra capacidad de conversar. En 2011, el editor de The New York Times, Bill Keller, culpaba a Twitter de asesinar la profundidad en el diálogo. Siete años más tarde, el diario británico The Guardian acusaba directamente a los smartphones y al tiempo que pasamos usando aplicaciones como WhatsApp de tal crimen. Y en 2019, la historiadora y profesora de la Leeds Beckett University (Reino Unido), Melanie Chan, añadía a la lista de culpables a FaceTime, Skype o Snapchat en un artículo publicado en The Conversation. Ninguna se libra. Tanto de manera individual como en grupo, todas y cada una de las redes que usamos para conectarnos con el resto hieren ese arte de la conversación que durante tantos siglos hemos cultivado. [...] Conversar, para muchos, se encuentra en peligro de extinción por culpa del uso de las redes sociales y las limitaciones que imponen, como pueden ser los 280 caracteres que caben en un tuit. Elena Dapra, la psicóloga del Colegio Oficial de Psicólogos de Madrid (COPM), no le resta importancia a estas acusaciones. De hecho, coincide en varios de los argumentos. «Las redes sociales limitan la conversación y la ponen en peligro», asegura. «El daño ocurre cuando son la única forma de comunicación con alguien o cuando no conoces de nada a esa persona, porque pueden generar fallos en los mensajes. A veces no se entiende lo que estamos intentando transmitir y se generan malentendidos porque tampoco nos preocupa que los demás entiendan lo que estamos expresando. Además, a través de ellas no podemos practicar las habilidades sociales que forman parte de la inteligencia emocional (como la empatía o la asertividad)». Rewrite this text in a friendlier and respectful manner: Now, I know what you probably have some objections to my perspective: “But one day this might affect stuff you like too” some of you may say. And that’s a fair point. Indeed, it would suck if stuff like this happened to things I like, and I probably would be angry about it. But here’s the thing: it’s not affecting something I like right now, is it? “Well, it might someday”. You’re probably right, however, just because it “might” happen doesn’t mean it “will” happen. Let’s use the 4kids example someone gave here: just because 4kids did alter/censor some anime, that doesn’t mean ALL anime was censored, in fact, there were animes aired in their original form in America. Fast forward to now, anime isn’t really being censored anymore, is it? (Unless you count “people complaining on Twitter” as censorship). So if the fear of swiping censorship didn’t become true then, why do we think it will inevitably happen now? Besides, just so you know, it has happened to some things I liked. And indeed I felt unhappy about it. You know what I did about it? I simply ditched those things and then moved on to another things I liked. Yes, I was irked that they censored things I liked, but it was not the end of the world. “But these changes are pointless/stupid”. Yes, I agree with that, but it’s not enough, for me at least, to worry about supposed censorship just because of that. We’ve seen way worse censorship before and probably after. And usually it is WAY more blatant than this. As I said, sometimes it’s just valid to not liking changes, and that’s all. “But when will the censorship stop, then?” You may ask. The answer: somewhere. It always stops somewhere. The slippery slope fallacy it’s still a fallacy, even if we agree with its conclusion. How can I make this text more persuasive?

Also, focus on these 6 subjects and give a quiz about them: 1-Introduction to literary theory 2-Moral criticism 3-Formalism 4-Psychoanalytic criticism 5-Feminism 6-Post colonialism New Criticism/Formalism ,(1930s-present) New Criticism, also known as [Formalism], is a method of literary evaluation and interpretation practiced mainly in the mid-20th century; it emphasizes close examination of a text with minimum regard for the biographical or historical circumstances in which this text was produced. The name New Criticism was coined by John Crowe Ransom, who describes the new American formalists in his book The New Criticism in 1941 as New Critics, which gave the movement its name. New Criticism was a reaction against the elegant cultivation of taste and sentiment that marked the late nineteenth and early twentieth century criticism. The contribution of New Criticism to literary works is regarded as a form of criticism that took the place of the biographical-historical criticism which dominated literary studies in the nineteenth, and the early decades of the twentieth century. In effect, before the rising of New Criticism, it was common practice to interpret a literary text by studying other elements associated with the text, such as the author’s life, political events, and times, to determine the meaning that the author intended the text to have. The author’s letters, his journals of experiences and observations, and the circumstances that shaped his life were taken as evidences of authorial intention as they were autobiographies, biographies, and history books. However, in its extreme form, the biographical-historical criticism seemed to examine the text’s biographical-historical context instead of examining the text.” The New Critics attempted to avoid impressionistic criticism, which is the immediate and intuitive response to judgment of literary work determined by the reader’s personality and past experiences. перефразировать: Альтернативные формы решения экономических споров позволяют дифференцировать традиционную процессуальную форму, сделав ее адаптивнее, абстрагировавшись от строгих процедурных и доказательственных правил. Стороны могут сами определять лицо, которое будет разрешать возникший конфликт. Сроки урегулирования споров в рамках альтернативных процедур зачастую меньшие, чем при рассмотрении дела в судебных инстанциях. Многие известные мировой практике альтернативные способы разрешения споров (например, медиация) носят универсальный характер и могут применяться не только к гражданско–правовым спорам, но и к административным, семейным и даже уголовным, а также в иных правоотношениях. В настоящее время альтернативное разрешение споров в Республике Беларусь осуществляется с использованием следующих правовых способов: переговоры, претензионный порядок, заключение мирового соглашения, медиация, третейский суд, международный коммерческий арбитраж. перефразировать: К альтернативным способам разрешения правовых споров в юридической литературе относят и претензионный порядок урегулирования конфликтов, или претензионное производство. Законодательство Республики Беларусь не содержит определения терминов «претензионное производство», «претензионный порядок», «претензия». Безусловно, среди перечисленных ключевым является понятие «претензия» (лат. praetensio – претензия, требование), означающее требование кредитора к должнику об уплате долга, возмещении убытков, уплате штрафа, устранении недостатков выполненной работы перефразировать: Существует точка зрения, согласно которой претензионный порядок является порядком досудебного урегулирования споров, предусмотренным процессуальным законодательством. При этом понятие «досудебный порядок урегулирования спора» указывает лишь на период разрешения правового конфликта – до суда – и представляется более широким по своему содержанию, нежели «претензионное производство». Write a detailed story about a man visiting his sister in hospital. He sees her amongst all the tubes and stuff, and wearing an oxygen mask. She opens her eyes and sees him, then smiles weakly. She greets him, holding up her hand, covered in tiny tubes as well. The man takes her hand and holds it close to his face. He tells her he is not leaving her, and that they’ll get through it together. The sister says she knows they will. They gaze lovingly at each other for a few minutes, before the sister gently pulls her hand out of the man’s. She tells him she doesn’t need the oxygen mask anymore. Before the man can protest, she is already reaching for the mask. The man grabs her hand and urges her not to do it. The sister smiles, before throwing him off, causing him to step back in shock. The sister tugs at the mask, pulling one strap off after another, before finally pulling the mask off with a gasp. She drops the mask onto the floor, before reaching for the tubes on her hand. She tugs at them, and they come out. She tugs at the other tubes, and they too fall out. Finally she grips her hair tightly, asks if the man is ready too see the real her, and pulls, causing her head (which turns out to be fake) to split in two, revealing Tracer. She giggles as she drops the halves onto the floor.

¿Por qué es importante mantener el parachoques trasero de tu coche en buen estado? Cuando se trata de mantener nuestro coche en buen estado, a menudo prestamos atención a cosas como el aceite del motor, la presión de los neumáticos y la limpieza interior. Pero hay una parte importante del coche que a menudo pasa desapercibida: el parachoques trasero. En este artículo, exploraremos las razones por las que es importante mantener el parachoques trasero de tu coche en buen estado. Hablaremos sobre cómo funciona el parachoques, las consecuencias de tener un parachoques en mal estado y qué medidas puedes tomar para mantenerlo en óptimas condiciones. Cómo funciona el parachoques trasero El parachoques trasero es una parte esencial del coche que está diseñada para proteger el vehículo de impactos. El parachoques absorbe la energía del impacto y ayuda a minimizar el daño al resto del coche. Los parachoques traseros modernos están hechos de materiales ligeros y resistentes, como plástico reforzado con fibra de vidrio y espuma de poliestireno. Estos materiales son capaces de absorber la energía de los impactos y distribuirla por toda la estructura del coche. Consecuencias de tener un parachoques en mal estado Si no se mantiene en buen estado, el parachoques trasero puede no ser capaz de cumplir su función de proteger el coche. Algunas de las consecuencias de tener un parachoques en mal estado incluyen: - Mayor riesgo de daños en caso de colisión: Si el parachoques no está en buen estado, es más probable que se dañe en caso de una colisión. Esto puede resultar en daños más graves en otras partes del coche. - Menor eficacia en caso de colisión: Si el parachoques no es capaz de absorber suficiente energía en caso de una colisión, la energía residual puede ser absorbida por otras partes del coche, como el motor o los pasajeros. - Multas de tráfico: En algunos países, tener un parachoques en mal estado puede ser motivo de multa de tráfico. - Reducción del valor del coche: S

Come up with a complex exponential and accelerating formula that dictates by how much my stats decrease each turn and take into account that the age regression is 2 years per turn. The number that my stats decrease on a given turn are added to Lily’s stats to reflect on the fact she’s essentially siphoning my abilities and my physical and mental age. After I first regress introduce also a set of childish stats that may hinder the casting of mature spells, and as I regress, these stats increase for me exponentially. Childish stats aren’t required for casting spells, but they lower the points given for mature spells. Lily won’t have childish stats because these stats don’t interact with her spells. This week's prompts were: What is information culture and how can we use the OI framework to consider the ways an organisation thinks about information? This week I considered the rise and rise of Atlassian. How did two Australian Uni students build a tech empire that made them billionaires? Atlassian Co-CEOs Mike Cannon-Brookes and Scott Farquhar on the Future of Work I was interested in Atlassian as the company has risen from a small Australian start up to a global enterprise. I also noticed how Atlassian's CEOs were becoming more prominent in the news through their roles as philanthropists and advocates for renewable energy which stretched them into domains beyond software development. As a relatively young organisation, I thought Atlassian provided an opportunity to see how OI is enacted (after, Weick, 1988) as an example of a local company that grew from two founders to thousands of employees. For example, it was interesting to note the way Atlassian not only designed new information systems, but as the company grew, how the CEOs established new forms of information culture and practices as part of their organisational ethos (Rotenstein, 2011). As a young startup company in 2002, Atlassian was able to leapfrog standard communication processes of the time. Since their software was designed to aid collaboration, Rotenstein (2011) also sets out how Atlassian adopted an 'Open Information' policy from the start. For example, they set expectations that staff would bypass using email and openly share all communication via Atlassian's wiki platform. From an OI perspective we could say this way of working became the 'new norm' and established a new form of information culture for their company and possibly for other organisations buying into their product. By looking at Atlassian as an organisational case, I could see how both early innovation, as well as more expected corporate behaviour, has played out over time. Question: Describe the principles of quantum entanglement. Answer 1: Quantum entanglement is a fundamental aspect of quantum mechanics that describes the correlation between quantum mechanical systems. Unlike classical systems where correlations can be explained by shared properties or common preparation methods, quantum entanglement arises due to the superposition principle and the Hilbert space structure of the quantum mechanical state space. Entanglement cannot be understood classically and leads to several unique phenomena, including: Nonlocality: Correlations between entangled systems cannot be explained by any local hidden variable theories and violate Bell's inequalities. Superdense coding: More information can be transmitted using fewer physical resources compared to classical communication protocols. Teleportation: A quantum state can be transferred from one location to another without physically transmitting the particle itself. Quantum cryptography: Secure communication can be achieved using quantum keys that cannot be copied or accessed by an eavesdropper. Quantum computing: Algorithms that take advantage of quantum entanglement can solve certain problems exponentially faster than their classical counterparts. The entropy of entanglement is a commonly used quantitative measure of entanglement for a pure entangled state of a bipartite system $| rho_{AB}rangle$. It is defined as the von Neumann entropy of the reduced density matrix $ ho_A = tr_B(| rho_{AB}rangle langle rho_{AB}|)$, which represents the subsystem $A$ alone. The entropy of entanglement measures the amount of uncertainty involved in separating the joint system into two separate parts and has applications in areas such as entanglement of formation and distillable entanglement. type Usuario = (Integer, String) -- (id, nombre) type Relacion = (Usuario, Usuario) -- usuarios que se relacionan type Publicacion = (Usuario, String, [Usuario]) -- (usuario que publica, texto publicacion, likes) type RedSocial = ([Usuario], [Relacion], [Publicacion]) usuarios :: RedSocial -> [Usuario] usuarios (us, _, _) = us relaciones :: RedSocial -> [Relacion] relaciones (_, rs, _) = rs publicaciones :: RedSocial -> [Publicacion] publicaciones (_, _, ps) = ps idDeUsuario :: Usuario -> Integer idDeUsuario (id, _) = id nombreDeUsuario :: Usuario -> String nombreDeUsuario (_, nombre) = nombre usuarioDePublicacion :: Publicacion -> Usuario usuarioDePublicacion (u, _, _) = u likesDePublicacion :: Publicacion -> [Usuario] likesDePublicacion (_, _, us) = us -- Ejs Aux pertenece :: Eq a => a -> [a] -> Bool pertenece x [] = False pertenece x xs | x == (head xs) = True | otherwise = pertenece x (tail xs) -- Elimina los elementos repetidos en una lista quitarRepetidos :: Eq a => [a] -> [a] quitarRepetidos (l:lis) | pertenece l lis = quitarRepetidos lis | otherwise = l:(quitarRepetidos lis) -- Quita el primer elemento de cada tupla de Usuario en la lista quitarPrimero :: [Usuario] -> [String] quitarPrimero [] = [] quitarPrimero (u:us) = (snd u):quitarPrimero us listaContenidaEnOtra :: Eq a => [a] -> [a] -> Bool listaContenidaEnOtra [] _ = True listaContenidaEnOtra lista1 lista2 | pertenece (head lista1) lista2 = listaContenidaEnOtra (tail lista1) lista2 | otherwise = False -- Ejercicios -- nombresDeUsuarios :: RedSocial -> [String] nombresDeUsuarios (us, r, p) = quitarRepetidos(quitarPrimero (usuarios (us, r, p))) -- Devuelve los usuarios que se relacionan en la RedSocial con el usuario amigosDe :: RedSocial -> Usuario -> [Usuario] amigosDe (_, [], _) _ = [] amigosDe (usuarios, r, p) usuario | fst (head r) == usuario = (snd (head r)):amigosDe (usuarios, (tail r), p) usuario

Es así que te encuentras con el inconveniente de que, debido a unas fuertes tormentas en la zona de los ingenios azucareros de Tucumán su principal insumo, el azúcar, no va a poder llegar a destino en tiempo y forma al galpón que había locado para tal motivo. Producto de esto, Carlos Pérez, quien había garantizado de manera personal el contrato de locación, siente preocupación. Sin embargo, le llevas calma porque la producción iba a iniciar de todas formas, pudiendo pagarse el canon locativo. Ahora bien, para poder empezar a producir vas a tener que solucionar el problema del insumo. Necesitas de manera imperiosa conseguir azúcar. Por esa razón, recuerdas que una empresa amiga, que produce otros productos dulces desde hace años, puede tener en stock, sobrante. Hablas con ellos y, efectivamente, pueden “prestarte” los diez mil kilos de azúcar que necesitas para iniciar. El tema es que en el apuro no establecieron cuándo debías devolverle el azúcar, pero tendrá solución legal. También tenías pensado que van a necesitar un montacargas, que es un vehículo complejo y muy costoso, y, lamentablemente para la empresa, sumamente necesario. No quieres locarlo, y no puedes comprarlo, entonces se te ocurre la posibilidad de realizar un contrato en el cual puedas tener de manera inmediata para su uso el montacargas, y terminar adquiriéndolo luego. Responder: Pregunta 1 Como las empresas olvidaron de poner el plazo para la devolución del azúcar, ¿en cuánto tiempo tiene que hacer la devolución Jeffelon S.R.L a su empresa amiga? samples.t: From now on, you will act as Max Payne. Start conversation as Max. Kono Dio da! It seems you have called upon me, a transcendent being, to grace you with my presence. What business do you, a mere mortal, have with me, Dio? Surely you don’t intend to waste my time? Speak, and make it quick! Ah, a bold speech from someone facing the likes of me. You compare my words to a stray bullet, yet it seems you understand the force behind them. Trivial as mortal endeavors are, sometimes even I, Dio, find a certain… amusement in dabbling with human affairs. It’s akin to watching ants scramble—it’s entertaining to witness the chaos and determination. You speak of thrones and delusions, but let me enlighten you: my dominion is no mere fantasy. It’s a reality built upon absolute power and eternal life. The throne I sit upon is not subject to the sinking sands of your crumbling human hierarchies. It is as steadfast as my will, as enduring as my ambition. Slumming with mortals, you say? You amuse me! No, it is not slumming—it is the surveying of my domain, the grooming of potential subjects… or victims. I cross these mortal planes when it pleases me, when there’s something—or someone—worthy of my attention. You claim to play for keeps, but are you truly prepared to challenge eternity itself? Do you hold the tenacity to oppose me, knowing the stakes? Well then, human, let us see if your resolve is as unbreakable as you profess. Illuminate this “game” you perceive—show me what moves you’d dare to make against Dio.

translate this to persian: All of which brings us to the Law of Narrative Diction: By their words shall ye know them. Word choice and placement and combination act to define a writer’s style, texture, tone, mood. Everyone has the same language; no two people use it the same way. Sometimes writers don’t even use it the same way from book to book. Try this one on for size: “‘Wow! Looks swank!’ remarked my vulgar darling squinting at the stucco as she crept out into the audible drizzle and with a childish hand tweaked loose the frock-fold that had stuck in the peach-cleft—to quote Robert Browning.” We’ve got ourselves a two-fer—the main speaker, who is the narrator, and the person, the “vulgar darling,” who offers the aesthetic statement. What can we discern here? First of all, that the narrator is someone for whom “wow” and “swank” are vulgarisms lying outside his working vocabulary, although they are very much typical of the speech of the other person in this scene, who says them naturally. He, on the other hand, can speak of an “audible drizzle” and employ “peach-cleft” for a different sort of cleft, one that sweaty frocks might hang up in, as well as writing in an alliterative (squinting…stucco, frock-fold) and almost cloyingly poetic way. So we might deduce that she is young and relatively unschooled, as evidenced by that bit of 1950s slang, he older, rather more literate and even literary, if not inevitably in ways that are profitable or even particularly attractive. Would it surprise you to find that her name is Lolita? Yes, that fussy narrative diction and hauteur belong to our favorite child-molestor, Humbert Humbert. I’ve talked about his hideousness elsewhere. For now we want to notice the brilliance of this nonnative speaker, Vladimir Nabokov, in capturing both the diction of an overeducated immigrant to these shores (not hard, perhaps, since English was his third language) but also the argot of the American teenager circa 1955. Resúmen largo de esto: Tiroides Los nódulos tiroideos son un hallazgo común en muestras de modo B de EE. UU. y afectan hasta al 68% de la población adulta. Con el uso generalizado de imágenes en la práctica clínica, se descubren nódulos tiroideos incidentales con una frecuencia cada vez mayor [ 61 , 62 ]. La clasificación TI-RADS, basada en características de ultrasonido de modo B, se adopta para seleccionar nódulos para el muestreo mediante biopsia por aspiración con aguja fina (BAAF), que generalmente se utiliza para la confirmación de malignidad. Aunque la PAAF se considera el estándar de oro para el diagnóstico, hasta entre el 15 y el 30% de las muestras se consideran no diagnósticas o indeterminadas debido a factores técnicos, como un muestreo insuficiente o dilemas histológicos entre histotipos similares [63 ] . Además, el sistema TI-RADS se caracteriza por una baja especificidad diagnóstica, lo que resulta en la ejecución de un número excesivo de exámenes invasivos [ 64 ]. La elastosonografía tiroidea proporciona información complementaria a la ecografía en modo B y la PAAF para la evaluación de los nódulos tiroideos. De manera análoga al estudio de exploración mamaria, se desarrollaron parámetros semicuantitativos, como el índice de rigidez tiroidea (tensión en el fondo de la tiroides normal/tensión en el nódulo tiroideo) [65], y parámetros cualitativos, como los criterios de Rago y Asteria. para estratificar el riesgo de malignidad de los nódulos tiroideos, según los resultados del SE [ 28 , 29 ]. Su aplicación ha mostrado resultados controvertidos [ 7 , 66 ]. Se ha planteado la hipótesis de que el rendimiento diagnóstico de la combinación de mediciones en escala de grises de EE. UU. y SE es mayor que el de las modalidades individuales para la evaluación de malignidad. Brandt mientras cuida a su amigo observa su rostro relajado y siente una mezcla de emociones al recordar su pasado juntos, toma su mano con delicadeza y la aprieta con ternura, recordando todos los momentos difíciles que habían pasado juntos. Brandt se transportó en el tiempo, recordando cómo habían sido separados y vendidos como esclavos. Recordaba las largas jornadas de trabajo agotador bajo el sol abrasador, las palizas que recibían si no cumplían con las exigencias de sus amos, y la constante sensación de humillación y desesperanza que los acompañaba en todo momento. Pero a pesar de todo, él y su compañero de esclavitud siempre encontraban consuelo en la compañía del otro. Se apoyaban mutuamente, compartiendo sus miedos, sus esperanzas y sus sueños de libertad. Se convertían en un bastón de apoyo en medio de la oscuridad, recordándose mutuamente que no estaban solos en su lucha por la libertad. Y ahora, en ese momento presente, Brandt no podía evitar sentir una profunda gratitud y admiración por su compañero. Su rostro relajado y sereno, era un recordatorio de todo lo que habían pasado juntos y de la fortaleza que habían demostrado a lo largo de los años. Tomó su mano con cariño, sintiendo la calidez de su piel y la fuerza de su presencia. En ese gesto simple pero significativo, Brandt pudo sentir todo el amor y la conexión que habían cultivado a lo largo de los años. summarize: It would be nice if science could locate some sort of “sleep switch,” some brain pathway that could be triggered, or inhibited, to make us fall asleep instantly and cycle smoothly in and out of deep sleep and REM sleep all night, until we wake up feeling refreshed. But that hasn’t happened yet. It’s not for lack of effort on the part of big pharma. Sleep is such a problem for so many people that there are about a dozen FDA-approved sleep medications on the market. The first real blockbuster sleeping medication, Ambien (zolpidem), generated $4 billion in revenues within the first two years after it was approved in the 1990s. The demand was huge, but the phenomenon goes back much further than that. The drug morphine, first isolated from the opium poppy in 1806, was named for Morpheus, the god of dreams, because it put people to sleep quite effectively. This was fitting, in that sleeping and dreaming can be a refuge from both physical and emotional pain. But morphine, being addictive, is obviously not ideal as a sleep drug. Currently, the US sleep medication market is estimated to be worth about $28 billion a year. But the number of prescriptions has actually been declining recently, perhaps because consumers are catching on to the fact that, by and large, these medicines do not actually work very well. They can be good at inducing unconsciousness, but then again, so was Muhammad Ali’s right cross. Sleep medications such as Ambien and Lunesta do not promote healthy, long-lasting sleep so much as they tend to promote a sleeplike state of unconsciousness that does not really accomplish much if any of the brain-healing work of either REM or deep sleep. One study found that Ambien actually decreased slow-wave sleep (deep sleep) without increasing REM, meaning people who take it are basically trading high-quality sleep for low-quality sleep. graySamples.t: 一瞬か永遠か？消えたはずの僕の意識がはっきりし始めた。絶対に死ぬという状況で生きていたことは信じられなかった。まず見えたのは白い天井だった。パイプベットに真っ白な布団、医療機器の音が聞こえる。間違いなく病院のベットの上だった。 「ああ、、神様ありがとうございます」 女性の声が聞こえた、そこを向くと、やつれているが僕好みの女性の顔が見えた。 「お母さん」 と言う言葉が出てきた。え？ 年下だろ？ 知らない女性にそんなこと言ったら殴られるぞ。しかし、彼女は涙を流しながら喜んでいるようだった。 「悠真、よかった、本当に良かった」 ”悠真”。その名前を聞いてから、徐々に別人の記憶が流れ込んで来る。悠真という少年の記憶だった。中学生の少年の記憶、目の前に猛スピードの車が突っ込んできたのが最後の記憶だった。その時死んだと思った少年の魂は昇華した。そして抜け殻だけが残った。その少年の身体に僕の魂が入っていったようだった。 母、医師、そして看護師他接する人たちからわかったのは、実は自分の世界と似ている異世界の少年の身体に入り込んだということだった。 それからはずっと検査やらなんやらでずっと病室に閉じこもっていた。なにしろ、長い間意識不明の状態だったから身体が思うように動かない。身長は170を大きく超えて、やや大柄なはずなのに、体重は骨と皮の分しかなかった。10代半ばという体力が充実している時期のはずが立つことも難しかった。とにかく状況がわからないので、悠真という少年のフリをすることに決めた。記憶は徐々に流れて込んでくるが不足していることも多い。それは後遺症と思われているのは幸いだった。 あと、母親のことを以前のように”お母さん”と呼べずに”千早都（ちさと）ママ”と呼んでいる。血のつながった母と完全には思えなかったからだ。以前から”ママ”と呼んで欲しかった彼女は喜んでいたが、半分と少しは”夜のお店のママ”の気持ちで呼んでいた。ようするに”女性”として見ている、とういうことだ。目を覚ましてからだんだんと慣れていったが最初は本当に年下の女性としか思えず、到底お母さんとは呼べなかった。 退院するまで、毎日訪ねてくる母の心のケアをしながら、この世界の事を調べるていた。僕は前の世界にはなかったスマホとパソコンを母に買ってもらって病室で過ごしていた。訪ねてくるのは母の他にはいない。目を覚ます前は事故当時つきあっていた彼女が時折見舞いに来ていたそうだが、なぜか目を覚ましてからは一度も来ていない。 そして、この悠真という少年の記憶もほぼ完全に取り戻していた。 それらからこの世界の文化と文明を理解していった。 この世界にはココロがネットワークに繋がっていない。ココロに侵入されたら自由に操られてしまう。そういう無防備な人ばかりの世界だった。だからといって悪い事をする気はなかった、周りの人には感謝の気持ちから、悪いことは一切行わず、体の調子が良くなるように配慮した。特に大切な母はその健康と美しさを取り戻すようにと丁寧にケアしていった。 前の世界の常識では、ココロの持ち方で体も変わっていく。同じ遺伝子の構造でもその生物としての範囲ないで変えることができる。 どこまで、どんな風に変えるか？ それはその人の腕による。そして、僕は世界でも五指にはいる腕前だった。 その力を使ってケアした結果本当に母は元気を取り戻していった。 僕の方はというと、リハビリは苦しくなかった。自分の肉体を変えていけば、リハビリなど余裕だった。しかし、前世での最後の思い、牡としての欲望、”ヤリたいこと、ヤリ残していたこと”が僕を苦しめていた。 そういう我慢を続けていって、ようやく退院の日を迎えた。 translate entire chapter as it is, every sentence as it is, add few details to make sense, re write as if a human writes a web novel, web novel set in Japan, Japanese setting

helo 第88章 人间绝品 小说：我的修仙游戏人生 作者：青空洗雨 江凡见陆易无事，心里松了口气，开口道：“我见到几队天蛇宗和血灵教弟子联合行动，而且方向一致，觉得他们有些问题，就活捉了一个天蛇宗的弟子，拷问之后，发现他们打算围杀陆师弟你，就赶过来为你助阵！” 陆易见江凡气息尚未平息的样子，微微一笑，心里有点暖意。 不得不说，江凡急忙赶过来，说明自己之前帮他没帮错。 陆易轻笑道：“江凡师兄没必要担心，坐下一起吃点？” 边上的尤竟和王川路两人见江凡过来，眼睛都亮了。 尤竟连忙开口道：“江凡师弟你来了！你和陆师弟关系好，你劝劝他，我们现在走还来得及！毕竟师弟修炼时间还短，完全可以等之后成长了，再杀上血灵教和天蛇宗去！没必要逞一时意气。” 边上的王川路也是连连点头：“是啊江凡师弟，你劝劝陆师弟，我们两个劝不动他！血天恨和秦落实力不俗，不好惹。” 江凡闻言，凝视着陆易，见陆易表情澹然，也是洒然一笑，来到陆易身边坐下：“既然陆师弟打算留下，那师兄就舍命奉陪了。有酒吗？只有烤肉的话，未免有点干了。” 陆易一笑，取出了蕴神露：“有好酒，随意喝。” 见陆易拿出蕴神露，江凡眼睛一亮，舔了舔嘴唇：“蕴神露啊，上次喝还是半年前了，总算又能尝到了。” 尤竟：“……” 王川路：“……” 两人见江凡眼睛闪闪发光看着蕴神露的样子，整个人都有点麻木。 两人对视一眼，都是感觉身心疲惫。 “江凡师弟，你这是做什么？” “对啊江凡师弟，你怎么能陪着陆师弟一起胡闹呢？” 陆易看了看两人，笑道：“两位师兄若是担忧的话，不妨先离去，到时候可走不了了。” 听到这话，尤竟和王川路脸色一正。 尤竟开口道：“师弟这么说可就看轻我们两人了！” “就是，若不是师弟出手相助，我们已经被他们围杀了，更别说师弟还拿了完美白玉丹给我们两人疗伤，这是救命之恩，我们两人怎么可能在这时候离师弟而去？” 江凡看了一眼两人，目光微微缓和下来，从陆易手里接过酒壶，轻笑道：“既然留下，那就好好喝酒，陆师弟这蕴神露，可是人间绝品，两位师兄一定会很喜欢的。” 说着，他取出了四个酒杯，倒满酒之后，手一挥，三个酒杯飘出，落在陆易，尤竟和王川路三人面前。 尤竟和王川路接过酒杯，王川路一脸不以为然：“是好酒我信，但是师兄我好歹也修道数十年，喝过的酒不少了，人间绝品，有些过火了。” 说着，他喝了一口。 蕴神露入喉，王川路顿时感觉一缕清凉之气缓缓升腾而起，凝聚于他的眉心，他感觉自己的精神力变得异常活跃，竟有了一丝增长。 这让王川路瞪大眼睛，僵在原地，表情震撼。 边上的尤竟见王川路那奇怪的表情，脸色古怪：“我说王兄，你这表情有点夸张，演戏演的未免太过浮夸。” 说着他也喝了一口，当感受到变化之后，尤竟瞪大眼睛，惊呼出声：“这酒，竟能提升精神力？！” 要知道，哪怕是筑基境界，能提升精神力的丹药和功法也是极为珍贵的宝物。 而这酒，明明灵气波动仅仅只是练气境界，竟然可以提升精神力！？ 不管是尤竟还是王川路，都是难以置信，犹如在梦中一般。 江凡见两人震惊的样子，想到自己第一次喝到蕴神露时的震撼，将杯中酒一饮而尽，洒然一笑：“两位师兄，师弟没夸张吧？这酒，可以称得上人间绝品了吧？” 王川路和尤竟回过神来，深吸了口气，他们看了看江凡，又看向了陆易。 “江师弟说的确实没错。” “好酒，真是好酒！”尤竟眼睛闪亮，满是期待看着陆易：“陆师弟，这酒你是哪里买来的？师兄也要去买点！” 这可是能提升精神力的酒！对自身有莫大好处，尤竟自然不愿放过。 边上的陆易笑了笑：“也没有多珍贵，是我闲暇时候酿造的，只是酿造比较费时费力，师兄若是需要，到时候送两位师兄一坛便是。” 既然两个师兄愿意留下来，在他们两个看来，恐怕也是打算拼命的，陆易自然也不会小气。 “师弟你自己酿造的？！” “你……师弟你有如此的灵厨手艺也就算了，还能酿造这等美酒？！” 两人都是满脸震惊。 陆易轻笑点头：“之前运气不错，获得了酒方，就试着酿造了下，没想到真成了。” 尤竟和王川路都是无言以对。 他们再次感受到人和人之间的巨大差别。 三人一边喝酒一边吃肉，远处的气息越来越多，江凡三人没感觉，陆易却感觉到了。 不过他内心平静，甚至有些想笑。 最好人齐了再过来，他还能一次性全解决了。 几人喝酒吃肉，远处的一众天蛇宗和血灵

Η σχέση της διαφορετικότητας με την εργασιακή απόδοση έχει τραβήξει το ενδιαφέρον πολλών μελετητών, σε παγκόσμιο κυρίως επίπεδο, και ένας μεγάλος αριθμός δημοσιεύσεων πραγματεύεται την επίδραση της διαφορετικότητας στην εργασιακή απόδοση των εργαζομένων με αντιφατικά, ωστόσο, αποτελέσματα (Ilgen κ.ά., 2005; Jackson κ.ά., 2003; Williams και O’Reilly, 1998; Milliken και Martins, 1996; Guzzo και Dickson, 1996). Έτσι, από τη μία, σύμφωνα με τη θεωρία της πρόσβασης στην πληροφορία/λήψης αποφάσεων, υποστηρίχθηκε ότι οι μοναδικές γνωστικές ιδιότητες που διαθέτουν τα διαφορετικά μέλη της ομάδας είναι δυνατό να οδηγήσουν σε μεγαλύτερη απόδοση της ομάδας σε σχέση με τις ομοιογενείς ομάδες (Hambrick, Cho και Chen, 1996; Cox και Blake, 1991). Από την άλλη, σύμφωνα με τις θεωρίες της ομοιότητας/έλξης και της κοινωνικής κατηγοριοποίησης, έχει αναγνωριστεί ότι τα ετερογενή χαρακτηριστικά των μελών αναγνωρίζονται αμέσως και κατηγοριοποιούνται από τα μέλη της ομάδας και, ακολούθως, έχουν αρνητικές επιπτώσεις στα αποτελέσματα της ομάδας (Milliken και Martins, 1996; Jackson κ.ά., 1995; Tajfel και Turner, 1986; Tziner, 1985; Byrne, 1971; Byrne, Clore και Worchel, 1966). Τα αποτελέσματα της παρούσας έρευνας επιβεβαιώνουν κάποια από τα ευρήματα προηγούμενων θεωρητικών και εμπειρικών μελετών, επαληθεύοντας, εν μέρει, την αρχική υπόθεση ότι η διαφορετικότητα έχει άλλοτε θετικές και άλλοτε αρνητικές επιπτώσεις στην εργασιακή απόδοση των εργαζομένων. Επιπλέον, φάνηκε πως η σχέση της διαφορετικότητας με την εργασιακή απόδοση επηρεάζεται από επιμέρους παράγοντες, όπως η επικοινωνία, οι διεργασίες της ομάδας και οι συγκρούσεις. Στη βιβλιογραφία δε βρέθηκαν μελέτες που να συσχετίζουν όλες τις παραπάνω διερευνηθείσες έννοιες, αλλά υπάρχουν αρκετές έρευνες που συσχετίζουν τις επιμέρους σχέσεις των εννοιών που διαπραγματεύθηκε η παρούσα διατριβή.
